title: Durable daemon session authority
description: Objective: land a production SqliteEventStore-backed principal/session/credential/capability authority, concrete proof-of-possession verifier, and durable replay guard for non-command transports. Depends on task-b4f12e63baca4ecc9f2c159ed3c3ad78. Before planning, obtain an explicit product decision for proof algorithm, canonical signed challenge bytes, key encoding, clock skew/TTL, renewal/rotation, and replay-key semantics; the pinned design leaves these open, so do not guess. NOT in scope: recipient/effect registries, coordination mailbox operations, MCP/HTTP listeners, or lifecycle command dispatch. Owned paths: apps/daemon/src/identity/session-authority-contracts.ts, session-authority-contracts.js, session-authority.ts, session-authority.js, session-authority.test.ts. Production consumers: the coordination-recipient registry prerequisite and task-4afcb06422ed4adb89430b7ea9758d7f. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/core test && pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test && pnpm typecheck.
definitionOfDone: The approved versioned proof protocol freezes algorithm, canonical challenge bytes, key encoding, TTL/skew, renewal, rotation, and replay-key semantics; unsupported, malformed, missing, or unverifiable protocol facts refuse with exact stable core code and layer.

Production create/open/renew/rotate/close operations commit and read exact principal, session, credential generation/client key, transport scope/capability, and replay facts through SqliteEventStore with idempotent receipt/digest preservation across store recreation.

Authentication calls the reusable core session seam with the concrete verifier and durable replay evidence; callers cannot inject positive verifier, replay, session, or capability answers, and private keys, plaintext credentials, and presented proofs are never persisted or logged.

Focused real-file tests create authority only through production writers and prove valid recreation plus forged, expired, replayed, rotated, revoked, unknown-session, and missing-capability refusals with exact code and layer, zero authority, unchanged durable state where required, and nonzero generated-case counts.

The exact verification command exits 0, every production file remains below 400 lines, and a frozen read/auth surface supplies authenticated active-session facts to the two named consumers without command, recipient, effect, or mailbox authority.
taskRails: Planning is blocked until the proof protocol choices are explicitly confirmed; do not invent cryptographic or clock semantics.
Persist durable evidence and public-key material only; never persist plaintext credentials, private keys, or presented proofs.
Coordination capabilities remain explicit transport scopes; never synthesize RuntimeCommandKinds or colon-containing core capability IDs.

comments.content: HUMAN PRODUCT DECISION APPROVED in the REPL on 2026-08-09. Protocol v1: Ed25519; canonical DER SPKI public keys persisted as lowercase hex; 64-byte signatures lowercase hex; clientKeyId=SHA-256(SPKI). Signed bytes are domain `moe.session-proof.v1` followed by fixed-order u32be-length-prefixed byte frames for principal, project, session, credential id/generation, client key, transport/scope, request id/digest, issued-at epoch milliseconds, and a 128-bit nonce. Proof TTL 60s with 30s future skew. Session TTL 15m, renewable only with a fresh current-generation proof up to an absolute 8h lifetime; renewal changes expiry only. Rotation atomically increments generation, replaces credential and client key, revokes the prior generation, and requires old-key plus new-key signatures over the same rotation challenge. Durable replay identity is (sessionId,generation,clientKeyId,nonce); reuse is SESSION_REPLAYED, while the same request may retry with a fresh nonce. This resolves the task's explicit product-decision rail. Planning remains dependency-gated on task-b4f12e63baca4ecc9f2c159ed3c3ad78.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: Treat this as the non-command-transport session authority that the coordination chain consumes, not as a rewrite of the existing bearer-oriented `session-services.ts`/`session-authenticator.ts` command path; those files remain out of scope and the new aggregate/event namespaces are explicit `session-authority.v1` identities. Keep four focused production leaves—contracts, approved proof protocol/crypto, event-store fold/commit, and orchestration—because combining Ed25519 canonicalization, hostile decoding, durable replay, lifecycle writes, and core composition in the original two TypeScript files would exceed the per-file focus target and put security/persistence concerns in one module. The required .js bridges account for four additional paths; the plan remains below the daemon hard limit of 10 distinct files. Use one session aggregate for lifecycle state, one principal aggregate for immutable principal creation, and a deterministic SHA-256 replay aggregate keyed by `(sessionId,generation,clientKeyId,nonce)` so concurrent different nonces do not contend and the raw nonce never enters events, result bytes, IDs, or logs. Mutation commands use SqliteEventStore command decisions for idempotent receipt/result-digest replay. planningNotes.risks: Canonical signed bytes must not drift: protocol v1 is ASCII domain `moe.session-proof.v1` followed by fixed-order u32be-length-prefixed frames for principalId, projectId, sessionId, credentialId, generation, clientKeyId, transportId, requestId, requestDigest, issuedAt, and nonce. Encode strings as UTF-8, safe integers as unsigned decimal ASCII without leading zeros, and digest/key/nonce fields as their required lowercase-hex ASCII spelling before framing; tests pin exact bytes, not a duplicate encoder. Require canonical Ed25519 DER SPKI round-trip, SHA-256(SPKI) clientKeyId, exactly 64-byte lowercase-hex signatures, 128-bit lowercase-hex nonce, <=60s proof age and <=30s future skew. Accept proof at the inclusive TTL/skew boundaries and refuse one millisecond beyond. Session expiry is exclusive, initial/renewal TTL is 15 minutes, and absolute lifetime is 8 hours from open; renewal changes only expiry. Rotation keeps session/principal/scopes/expiry, increments generation exactly once, revokes the old credential, installs the new public key/credential, and verifies both old and new signatures over the same challenge bytes whose requestDigest binds the proposed new material. Store only public key/material and digests: never raw signature, nonce, challenge, proof object, plaintext credential, or private key. An unreadable/unknown event fold is UNKNOWN/BINDING and never a partial positive record. A valid proof may burn its replay digest before a later core generation/state/expiry/transport refusal, matching core's fixed precedence; tests distinguish authority state (unchanged) from the append-only replay fact. Idempotent mutation replay still authenticates where a current session is required and returns the original stored receipt/result bytes.
